Overview

Bangkok is a city in Bangkok with a population of 10,539,000. Thailand’s vibrant capital blends ancient temples with modern skyscrapers, offering world-class street food, a thriving expat community, and a cost of living that’s a fraction of Western cities. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year.
